record.title: Corrupt KV value silently returns an empty board; the next write then overwrites (destroys) the stored data
record.description: The code pattern is real in isolation — loadTickets() at lines 71-80 returns [] on JSON parse failure or a non-array object without .tickets, and POST /api/tickets then load-push-saves that [] plus one new ticket, overwriting the corrupt KV value. A local mock-KV simulation of the verbatim functions confirmed this: corrupt fixture loaded as [], wrong-shape {"foo":1} loaded as [], and a POST-style load+push+save left KV as {"tickets":[new ticket]} with the original ticket gone. But as a finding it fails the 7-Question Gate and is rejected: there is no realistic trigger and no attacker path. The sole writer in the repo is saveTickets() (line 83), which always writes JSON.stringify({tickets, updated_at}) — valid JSON — and there is no other TICKETS.put in the codebase; a KV put is a single atomic write, so a partial write is not a realistic trigger. Corruption would require an already-broken state: a manual operator edit via the Cloudflare dashboard/wrangler kv:put, or another writer sharing the namespace — neither evidenced. An attacker cannot create that state through the API (all /api/* writes go through saveTickets and produce valid JSON), and triggering the overwrite requires the privileged BOARD_TOKEN, so Q1 and Q4 fail. Only POST /api/tickets is destructive after corruption; PATCH/DELETE/comments/mark-sent first do findIndex on the [] load, get -1, and return 404 before any save. Q6 also fails: no live proof (correctly not attempted against live KV) and the board is currently EMPTY per the build report, so there is no data at risk today — a corrupt empty board is indistinguishable from an empty board and a create would destroy nothing. This is at most a defensive-coding / reliability hardening note, not a security finding or a reportable reliability bug. Remediation assessed as correct in direction but optional: fail-closed (loadTickets should throw/return a sentinel, handlers return a distinct 500, and POST must refuse to save) plus a backup KV key written only on successful loads/saves (never backing up a corrupt value) would fix it, but it is hardening, not a required fix.

trace.what: loadTickets catch returns [] on JSON.parse failure; line 78 returns parsed.tickets || [] for non-array objects, so corrupt/wrong-shape KV is indistinguishable from an empty board
POST /api/tickets loads tickets ([]) then pushes the new ticket; PATCH/DELETE/comments/mark-sent (lines 391, 411, 421, 432) instead 404 on findIndex -1 before any save, so only create propagates
saveTickets overwrites KV key 'tickets' with JSON.stringify({tickets, updated_at}); called from POST at line 383, destroying the prior corrupt value irreversibly (no backup/version)

evidence.output: 41: const KV_KEY = "tickets"; 71: async function loadTickets(env) { 72: const raw = await env.TICKETS.get(KV_KEY); 82: async function saveTickets(env, tickets) { 83: await env.TICKETS.put(KV_KEY, JSON.stringify({ tickets, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })); 358: GET loadTickets; 381: POST loadTickets; 383: saveTickets; 391: loadTickets (id routes); 411/421/432/437: saveTickets (comments/mark-sent/PATCH/DELETE). Only one TICKETS.put in the whole repo (line 83); sole writer always emits valid JSON.

evidence.command: node /tmp/board-corrupt-sim.mjs (verbatim loadTickets/saveTickets lines 71-84 against a mock KV in /tmp; live KV untouched, no board key used)
evidence.output:
load corrupt: []
load wrong-shape: []
KV after POST on corrupt: {"tickets":[{"id":"new","title":"new ticket"}],"updated_at":"2026-11-14T20:27:27.335Z"}
original ticket survives? false

record.remediation: Optional hardening only, not a required fix: make loadTickets throw (or return a corrupt sentinel) instead of []; handlers return a distinct 500 (e.g. board_corrupt) and refuse all writes, especially POST create, until repaired; optionally write a backup KV key on each successful save (copy of the last good value, only when the load parsed cleanly) with a documented restore step. Correct as proposed, with the caveat that the guard must cover POST create specifically, since the other mutating routes already 404 before saving.
record.reason: Fails the 7-Question Gate: Q1 — no attacker-usable step-by-step request (attacker cannot corrupt KV via the API, and the overwrite needs the privileged BOARD_TOKEN); Q4 — requires privileged access plus an already-broken KV state; Q6 — impact beyond 'technically possible' not proven, and the board is currently empty so impact today is zero. Realistic trigger absent: the sole writer always writes valid JSON via an atomic KV put, so corruption requires manual operator error or an unevidenced second writer. Three preconditions (corrupt KV + non-empty board + authenticated create) exceed the kill-fast limit. Reclassify as a defensive-coding note, not a security or reliability finding.
